title: Frontend: Tiptap rich text editor integration (bold, italic, lists, links, code blocks)
description: Install and configure Tiptap editor for journal entries. Supports bold, italic, bullet lists, ordered lists, links, and code blocks.
acceptanceCriteria: Tiptap editor renders in a card with a toolbar
Toolbar buttons: Bold, Italic, Bullet List, Ordered List, Link, Code Block, Horizontal Rule
Editor content serializes to JSON (for storage) and renders from JSON (for display)
Read-only mode renders journal entries as HTML
Placeholder text shown when editor is empty

steps.details: Create src/components/editor/RichTextEditor.tsx. Use useEditor from Tiptap with extensions: StarterKit, Link, CodeBlockLowlight. Props: content (JSON string), onChange(json: string), readOnly: boolean. Show toolbar with icon buttons for formatting. Use EditorContent to render.
Create src/components/editor/RichTextViewer.tsx. Read-only Tiptap instance that renders stored JSON. Used in journal entry cards and share page.
In the create/edit journal entry dialog (TASK-98), replace basic textarea with RichTextEditor. Store editor.getJSON() as the body value.
Open journal entry form. Type formatted content (bold text, a list, a code block). Submit — verify saved. View entry — verify formatting renders correctly.
